sentences.zh: 二年春正月己巳朔，安南、占城各遣使來貢方物。

translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on jisi new moon, Annam and Champa each dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.

translations.idiomatic: On renzi day famine at Baoding Xiongzhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚午，廣太廟。

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Grand Ancestral Temple was expanded.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禁漢人執兵器出獵及習武藝。

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Han people were forbidden to carry weapons when going hunting and to practice martial arts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯昴。

translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 親祀太廟，始陳鹵簿，賜導駕耆老幣帛。

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; for the first time the guard of honor was displayed; silks and cloths were granted to the aged who guided the carriage.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，敕有司存恤孔氏子孫貧乏者。

translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict directed the authorities to preserve and relieve impoverished descendants of the Kong clan.

translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Shandong, Baoding, Henan, Bianliang, Guide, Xiangyang, Runing, and other places suffered famine; 395,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Venus encroached upon Establishment Star.

sentences.zh: 公主阿剌忒納八剌下嫁，賜鈔五十萬貫。

translations.literal: Princess Alatenabala was given in marriage; five hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Alatenabala was given in marriage; 500,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太白犯建星。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Venus encroached upon Establishment Star.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Venus encroached upon Establishment Star.

translations.idiomatic: Yifeng County's river overflow damaged crops; relief was given.

translations.idiomatic: On guimou day Huizheng Bureau commissioner Luo Yuan was exiled to Tamna.

translations.idiomatic: A traveling palace was built at Willow Grove.

translations.literal: Tachar was enfeoffed as Duke of Lan State.
translations.idiomatic: Tachar was enfeoffed as Duke of Lan State.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太陰犯心。

translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon encroached upon Heart.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以西僧羅藏為司徒。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Western monk Luozang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Western monk Luozang was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 漷州饑，糶米十萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Huozhou suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huozhou suffered famine; 100,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Mars encroached upon Room.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Mars encroached upon Room.

translations.literal: On dingyou day Venus encroached upon Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Venus encroached upon Ox.

translations.literal: Second month, on jihai new moon, Mars encroached upon Establishment and Enclosure stars.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on jihai new moon, Mars encroached upon Establishment and Enclosure stars.

sentences.zh: 庚子，置左、右欽察衛親軍都指揮使司，命拜住總之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Left and Right Qincha Guard Elite Army Command offices were established; Baizhu was ordered to command them overall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Left and Right Qincha Guard Elite Army Command offices were established; Baizhu was ordered to command them overall.

sentences.zh: 罷上都歇山殿及帝師寺役。

translations.literal: Construction labor at Shangdu's Xieshan Hall and the Imperial Preceptor's Temple was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Construction labor at Shangdu's Xieshan Hall and the Imperial Preceptor's Temple was halted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜鐵失父祖碑。

translations.literal: On xinchou day a stele was granted to Tieshi's father and grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day a stele was granted to Tieshi's father and grandfather.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Jiangnan branch censorate chief censor Qincha was made central secretariat grand councillor; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat associate administrator Wang Juren was made central secretariat associate administrator; Xue Chujing was dismissed and made Henan branch secretariat left vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，熒惑犯罰星。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Mars encroached upon Punishment Star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Mars encroached upon Punishment Star.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wushen day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.

translations.idiomatic: Nine counties of Shunde Route suffered flood and drought; relief was given.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯井。

translations.literal: The moon encroached upon Well.
translations.idiomatic: The moon encroached upon Well.

translations.literal: On gengxu day Mars encroached upon Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Mars encroached upon Eastern Wall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太陰犯酒旗及軒轅。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the moon encroached upon Wine Banner and Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the moon encroached upon Wine Banner and Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On renzi day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王案忒不花鈔七萬五千貫。

translations.literal: Prince Attebuhua was granted seventy-five thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Attebuhua was granted 75,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 以徹兀臺禿忽魯死事，賜鈔三萬五千貫。

translations.literal: Because Chiwutai Tuhulu died in service, thirty-five thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Chiwutai Tuhulu died in service, 35,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 諸王怯伯遣使進文豹。

translations.literal: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting a literary leopard.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting a literary leopard.

sentences.zh: 河間路饑，禁釀酒。

translations.literal: Hejian Route suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian Route suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯明堂。

translations.literal: On guichou day the moon encroached upon Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon encroached upon Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以太廟役軍造流杯池行殿。

translations.literal: On jiayin day troops levied for Grand Ancestral Temple labor were ordered to build the flowing-cup pool traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day troops levied for Grand Ancestral Temple labor were ordered to build the flowing-cup pool traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 廣海郡邑官曠員，敕願往任者，升秩二等。

translations.literal: Official vacancies existed in commanderies and counties of Guanghai Circuit; an edict directed that those willing to take appointment be promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Official vacancies existed in commanderies and counties of Guanghai Circuit; an edict directed that those willing to take appointment be promoted 2 ranks.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以遼陽行省平章政事買驢為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On yimao day Liaoyang branch secretariat grand councillor Maidon was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Liaoyang branch secretariat grand councillor Maidon was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 西僧亦思剌蠻展普疾，詔為釋大辟囚一人、笞罪二十人。

translations.literal: The Western monk Yisilaman Zhanpu was ill; an edict ordered release of one prisoner under capital sentence and twenty under flogging punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Western monk Yisilaman Zhanpu was ill; an edict ordered release of 1 prisoner under capital sentence and 20 under flogging punishment.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑真定等路饑。

translations.literal: On wuwu day famine in Zhending and other routes was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day famine in Zhending and other routes was relieved.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 括馬賜宗仁衛。

translations.literal: Horses were requisitioned and granted to the Zongren Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Horses were requisitioned and granted to the Zongren Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On renxu day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 諸王怯伯遣使進海東青鶻。

translations.literal: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting eastern Qing falcons.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting eastern Qing falcons.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遼陽等路饑，免其租，仍賑糧一月。

translations.literal: On guihai day Liaoyang and other routes suffered famine; their land tax was remitted, and one month's grain was still issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Liaoyang and other routes suffered famine; their land tax was remitted, and 1 month's grain was still issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，恩州水，民饑、疫，賑之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Enzhou suffered flooding; the people suffered famine and pestilence; relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Enzhou suffered flooding; the people suffered famine and pestilence; relief was given.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，中書省臣言：「國學廢弛，請令中書平章政事廉恂、參議中書事張養浩、都事孛術魯翀董之。

translations.literal: Third month, jisi day, central secretariat officials said: "The National University has fallen into neglect; we request that central secretariat grand councillor Lian Xun, deliberating official of central secretariat affairs Zhang Yanghao, and secretariat bureau director Bolu Chong supervise it.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jisi day, central secretariat officials said, "The National University has fallen into neglect; we request that central secretariat grand councillor Lian Xun, deliberating official of central secretariat affairs Zhang Yanghao, and secretariat bureau director Bolu Chong supervise it.

sentences.zh: 外郡學校，仍命御史臺、翰林院、國子監同議興舉。

translations.literal: For schools in outer commanderies, the censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Directorate of Education are still ordered to deliberate jointly on reviving them.
translations.idiomatic: For schools in outer commanderies, the censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Directorate of Education are still ordered to deliberate jointly on reviving them.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 敕四宿衛、興聖宮及諸王部勿用南人。

translations.literal: An edict directed that the Four Guards, Xingsheng Palace, and princes' establishments not employ southerners.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that the Four Guards, Xingsheng Palace, and princes' establishments not employ southerners.

sentences.zh: 斡魯思告訐父母，斬之。

translations.literal: Wolusi denounced his parents; he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Wolusi denounced his parents; he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁捕天鵝，違者籍其家。

translations.literal: On xinwei day capture of swans was forbidden; violators' households would be registered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day capture of swans was forbidden; violators' households would be registered.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復張珪司徒。

translations.literal: On renshen day Zhang Gui was restored as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Zhang Gui was restored as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 臨安路河西諸縣饑，賑之。

translations.literal: Famine in the western He counties of Lin'an Route was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in the western He counties of Lin'an Route was relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河南兩淮諸郡饑，禁釀酒。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Henan and Liang-Huai commanderies suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Henan and Liang-Huai commanderies suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丙子，延安路饑，賑糧一月。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Yan'an Route suffered famine; one month's grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yan'an Route suffered famine; 1 month's grain was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 罷京師諸營繕役卒四萬餘人。

translations.literal: More than forty thousand construction laborers of various camps in the capital were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: More than 40,000 construction laborers of various camps in the capital were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 河間、河南、陜西十二郡春旱秋霖，民饑，免其租之半。

translations.idiomatic: 12 commanderies of Hejian, Henan, and Shaanxi suffered spring drought and autumn rains; the people suffered famine; half their land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，修都城。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the capital city was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the capital city was repaired.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，敕：「江浙僧寺田，除宋故有永業及世祖所賜者，余悉稅之。

translations.literal: Edict: "Of Jiang-Zhe monastic temple lands, except for Song-era permanent estates and those granted by Shizu, the remainder shall all be taxed.

translations.literal: " On guimou day famine among Jurchen and Han military households in Liaoyang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimou day famine among Jurchen and Han military households in Liaoyang was relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑濮州水災。

translations.literal: On yiyou day flooding disaster in Puzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day flooding disaster in Puzhou was relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以親祀禮成，賜與祭者幣。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, because the rite of personally sacrificing was completed, silks were granted to those who participated in the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because the rite of personally sacrificing was completed, silks were granted to those who participated in the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 普減內外官吏一資。

translations.literal: Officials inside and outside were uniformly reduced one rank of seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Officials inside and outside were uniformly reduced 1 rank of seniority.

sentences.zh: 萬戶哈剌那海以私粟賑軍，賜銀、幣，仍酬其直。

translations.idiomatic: Myriarch Qara Nauqai used private grain to relieve the army; silver and silks were granted, and he was still compensated at market price.

sentences.zh: 給行通政院印。

translations.literal: The seal of the itinerant Communications Court was issued.
translations.idiomatic: The seal of the itinerant Communications Court was issued.

sentences.zh: 賜潛邸四宿衛士鈔有差。

translations.literal: Notes were granted in varying amounts to the four guard corps of the former heir apparent's residence.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were granted in varying amounts to the 4 guard corps of the former heir apparent's residence.

sentences.zh: 復置市舶提舉司於泉州、慶元、廣東三路，禁子女、金銀、絲綿下番。

translations.literal: Maritime Trade Intendant's offices were re-established in Quanzhou, Qingyuan, and Guangdong circuits; women, children, gold, silver, silk, and cotton were forbidden from sailing overseas.
translations.idiomatic: Maritime Trade Intendant's offices were re-established in Quanzhou, Qingyuan, and Guangdong circuits; women, children, gold, silver, silk, and cotton were forbidden from sailing overseas.

translations.literal: On dinghai day Fengxiang Daoist Wang Daoming was executed for sorcerous speech.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Fengxiang Daoist Wang Daoming was executed for sorcerous speech.

sentences.zh: 己丑，有暈貫日如連環。

translations.literal: A halo encircled the sun like linked rings.
translations.idiomatic: A halo encircled the sun like linked rings.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王斡魯溫孫銀印。

translations.literal: Prince Oluwunsun was granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Oluwunsun was granted a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 命有司建木華黎祠於東平，仍樹碑。

translations.literal: The authorities were ordered to build a shrine to Muqali at Dongping and also erect a stele.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities were ordered to build a shrine to Muqali at Dongping and also erect a stele.

translations.idiomatic: Because state revenues were exhausted, grants to princes and the annual stipends of Empress Dalanmishili and others were halted.

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Caozhou and Huazhou suffered famine; relief was given.

translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Construction was ordered to remake the ceremonial cap with pendant beads.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣御史錄囚。

translations.literal: On xinmao day censors were dispatched to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day censors were dispatched to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 置甘州八剌哈孫驛。

translations.literal: The Baqalarsun relay station in Ganzhou was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Baqalarsun relay station in Ganzhou was established.

sentences.zh: 監察御史何守謙坐贓杖免。

translations.literal: Surveillance censor He Shouqian was flogged and dismissed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance censor He Shouqian was flogged and dismissed for corruption.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑上都十一驛。

translations.literal: On renchen day eleven relay stations at Shangdu were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day 11 relay stations at Shangdu were relieved.

sentences.zh: 給宗仁衛蒙古子女衣糧。

translations.literal: Clothing and grain were issued to Mongol children of the Zongren Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Clothing and grain were issued to Mongol children of the Zongren Guard.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王脫烈鐵木兒鈔五萬貫。

translations.literal: Prince Tuolie Temür was granted fifty thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tuolie Temür was granted 50,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遼陽哈裏賓民饑，賑之。

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸柳林。

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Emperor visited Willow Grove.

translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "A son's duty to parents is to conceal and not expose; now when they err he does not remonstrate, yet again denounces them.

sentences.zh: 」命誅之。

translations.literal: " An order was given to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: An order was given to execute him.

translations.literal: Famine in Fengyuan Route was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Fengyuan Route was relieved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu new moon, the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu new moon, the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，嶺北蒙古軍饑，給糧遣還所部。

translations.literal: On jihai day Mongol troops of Lingbei suffered famine; grain was issued and they were sent back to their units.

translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gui, ill with foot disease, was exempted from court congratulations.

translations.idiomatic: Two intendant offices for Empress Renzong's palace rank were established at fifth grade, subordinate to the Chenghui Temple.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Well.

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Tieshi was again ordered to invigorate the censorate framework.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day earth fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 京師饑，發粟二萬石賑糶。

translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain were issued for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 造五輅旗。

translations.literal: The flags of the five regalia carriages were made.
translations.idiomatic: The flags of the 5 regalia carriages were made.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕金書《藏經》二部，命拜住等總之。

translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed that 2 sets of the gold-written Buddhist canon be made, with Baizhu and others placed in overall charge.

sentences.zh: 戊午，封鷹師不花為趙國公。

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Yingshi Buhua was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao State.

translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, because crown prince guest Bodulian was impoverished, 100,000 strings of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 諸王月思別遣使來朝。

translations.idiomatic: Prince Yesi Bie dispatched envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 罷稱海宣慰司及萬戶府，改立屯田總管府。

translations.idiomatic: The Chenghai pacification commission and myriarch office were abolished, and a garrison-farm overall directorate was established in their place.

sentences.zh: 諸王怯伯遣使貢蒲萄酒。

translations.literal: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qiebo dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.

sentences.zh: 海漕糧至直沽，遣使祀海神天妃。

translations.literal: When sea-transport grain arrived at Zhigu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea goddess Tianfei.
translations.idiomatic: When sea-transport grain arrived at Zhigu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea goddess Tianfei.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: Third month, on renchen new moon, the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renchen new moon, the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.

translations.literal: Prince Nandashi was granted two million five hundred thousand strings of notes, and Prince Tuohuan's annual grant was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Nandashi was granted 2,500,000 strings of notes, and Prince Tuohuan's annual grant was restored.

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Jiading Prefecture in Pingjiang Route suffered famine; 60,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，安豐芍陂屯田女直戶饑，賑糧一月。

translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Jurchen households of the Shaopi garrison farm in Anfeng suffered famine; grain was granted for 1 month.

sentences.zh: 庚子，崇明諸州饑，發米萬八千三百石賑之。

translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Chongming and other prefectures suffered famine; 18,300 shi of rice were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，臺州路黃巖州饑，賑糧兩月。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Route suffered famine; grain was granted for two months.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Route suffered famine; grain was granted for 2 months.

sentences.zh: 丁未，西番參卜郎諸族叛，敕鎮西武靖王搠思班等發兵討之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Canbolang tribes of the Western Tibetans rebelled; Western Pacification Martial Restraint Prince Tuosiban and others were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Canbolang tribes of the Western Tibetans rebelled; Western Pacification Martial Restraint Prince Tuosiban and others were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress them.

translations.literal: On wushen day the Grand Empress Dowager was enshrined in Emperor Shunzong's temple chamber; Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies and central secretariat right chancellor Baizhu was dispatched bearing the jade register and jade seal to confer the honorific title Empress Zhao Xian Yuan Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Grand Empress Dowager was enshrined in Emperor Shunzong's temple chamber; Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies and central secretariat right chancellor Baizhu was dispatched bearing the jade register and jade seal to confer the honorific title Empress Zhao Xian Yuan Sheng.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以圓明、王道明之亂，禁僧、道度牒、符錄。

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because of the disorder of Yuanming and Wang Daoming, Buddhist and Daoist ordination certificates and talismans were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」監察御史拜住、教化，坐舉八思吉思失當，並黜免。

translations.literal: " Supervising censors Baizhu and Jiaohua, for improperly recommending Basijisi, were both dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censors Baizhu and Jiaohua, for improperly recommending Basijisi, were both dismissed.

sentences.zh: 諸王火魯灰部軍驛戶饑，賑之。

translations.literal: Relay-households of Prince Huoluhui's division army suffered famine; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Relay-households of Prince Huoluhui's division army suffered famine; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌朔，敕天下諸司命僧誦經十萬部。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renxu new moon, an edict directed all offices throughout the realm to have monks recite one hundred thousand sutra sections.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on renxu new moon, an edict directed all offices throughout the realm to have monks recite 100,000 sutra sections.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，察罕腦兒蒙古軍驛戶饑，賑之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day relay-households of the Mongol army at Chaghan Na'ur suffered famine; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day relay-households of the Mongol army at Chaghan Na'ur suffered famine; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，旌內黃縣節婦王氏。

translations.literal: On dingmao day chaste widow Wang of Neihuang County was commended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day chaste widow Wang of Neihuang County was commended.

sentences.zh: 己巳，浚金水河。

translations.literal: On jisi day the Jinshui River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Jinshui River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命張珪及右司員外郎王士熙勉勵國子監學。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Zhang Gui and right secretariat section director Wang Shixi were ordered to encourage study at the Directorate of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhang Gui and right secretariat section director Wang Shixi were ordered to encourage study at the Directorate of the National University.

sentences.zh: 敕都功德使闊兒魯至京師。

translations.literal: An edict directed chief merit commissioner Kuo'erlu to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed chief merit commissioner Kuo'erlu to come to the capital.

sentences.zh: 釋囚大辟三十一人，杖五十七以上者六十九人。

translations.literal: Thirty-one prisoners guilty of capital offenses were released, and sixty-nine guilty of beatings of fifty-seven strokes or more.
translations.idiomatic: 31 prisoners guilty of capital offenses were released, and 69 guilty of beatings of 57 strokes or more.

sentences.zh: 放籠禽十萬，令有司償其直。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand caged birds were released, and the relevant offices were ordered to compensate their value.
translations.idiomatic: 100,000 caged birds were released, and the relevant offices were ordered to compensate their value.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔行助役法，遣使考視稅籍高下，出田若干畝，使應役之人更掌之，收其歲入以助役費，官不得與。

translations.literal: On jimao day an edict proclaimed the corvée-assistance law: envoys were dispatched to examine tax registers for high and low assessments; fields of set acreage were assigned to corvée-duty persons to manage in rotation, collecting yearly income to defray corvée expenses — the government was not to participate.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict proclaimed the corvée-assistance law: envoys were dispatched to examine tax registers for high and low assessments; fields of set acreage were assigned to corvée-duty persons to manage in rotation, collecting yearly income to defray corvée expenses — the government was not to participate.

sentences.zh: 北邊軍饑，賑之。

translations.literal: Northern frontier armies suffered famine; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Northern frontier armies suffered famine; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 蒙古大千戶部，比歲風雪斃畜牧，賑鈔二百萬貫。

translations.literal: The Mongol great qianhu division, whose livestock had perished in wind and snow these past years, was granted two million strings of notes in relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol great qianhu division, whose livestock had perished in wind and snow these past years, was granted 2,000,000 strings of notes in relief.

sentences.zh: 敕京師萬安、慶壽、聖安、普慶四寺，揚子江金山寺、五臺萬聖祐國寺，作水陸佛事七晝夜。

translations.literal: An edict directed the four temples Wan'an, Qing Shou, Sheng'an, and Puqing in the capital, Jinshan Temple on the Yangzi River, and Wansheng Youguo Temple on Wutai to perform seven days and nights of water-and-land Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the 4 temples Wan'an, Qing Shou, Sheng'an, and Puqing in the capital, Jinshan Temple on the Yangzi River, and Wansheng Youguo Temple on Wutai to perform 7 days and nights of water-and-land Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，故羅羅斯宣慰使述古妻漂末權領司事，遣其子娑住邦來獻方物。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the widow Piaomo of the late Luoluosi pacification commissioner Shugu, acting in charge of the office, dispatched her son Suozhubang to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the widow Piaomo of the late Luoluosi pacification commissioner Shugu, acting in charge of the office, dispatched her son Suozhubang to present tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 戊子，南豐州民及鞏昌蒙古軍饑，賑之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the people of Nanfeng Prefecture and the Mongol army of Gongchang suffered famine; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the people of Nanfeng Prefecture and the Mongol army of Gongchang suffered famine; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，設大理路白鹽城榷稅官，秩正七品；

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinmao day a salt monopoly tax official was established at Baiyan City in Dali Route, rank 7a;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinmao day a salt monopoly tax official was established at Baiyan City in Dali Route, rank 7a;

sentences.zh: 中慶路榷稅官，秩從七品。

translations.literal: a salt monopoly tax official in Zhongqing Route, rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: a salt monopoly tax official in Zhongqing Route, rank 7b.

translations.literal: Anqing Qianshan County and Yunnan Ningyuan Prefecture were established.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing Qianshan County and Yunnan Ningyuan Prefecture were established.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大風雨雹，拔柳林行宮內外大木二千七百。

translations.literal: On gengzi day great wind, rain, and hail uprooted two thousand seven hundred large trees inside and outside the Willow Grove traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day great wind, rain, and hail uprooted 2,700 large trees inside and outside the Willow Grove traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鐵失獨署御史大夫事。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Tieshi was entrusted alone with censor-in-chief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Tieshi was entrusted alone with censor-in-chief affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雲南行省平章政事忽辛坐贓杖免。

translations.literal: On renyin day Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor Huxin, for corruption, was beaten and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor Huxin, for corruption, was beaten and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔中外開言路。

translations.literal: An edict opened the path for memorializing inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict opened the path for memorializing inside and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 置慶元路嶧山縣，增尉一員。

translations.literal: Yishan County was established in Qingyuan Route, and one patrol inspector was added.
translations.idiomatic: Yishan County was established in Qingyuan Route, and 1 patrol inspector was added.

sentences.zh: 徙安寨縣於龍安驛。

translations.literal: Anzhai County was relocated to Long'an Post.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhai County was relocated to Long'an Post.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Room.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，嶺北米貴，禁釀酒。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because grain was costly in Lingbei, wine-brewing was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, because grain was costly in Lingbei, wine-brewing was forbidden.

translations.literal: On wushen day supervising censors Gai Jiyuan and Song Yi said: "Tiemudie'er is devious, greedy, and corrupt; we request that the stele erected for him be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day supervising censors Gai Jiyuan and Song Yi said, "Tiemudie'er is devious, greedy, and corrupt; we request that the stele erected for him be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍追奪官爵及封贈制書。

translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Jinghu pacification commissioner Tuolie accepted bribes; when the matter came to light he was summoned to the capital; censorate officials requested he be sent back for trial locally — this was not approved.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜勛舊子撒兒蠻、按灰鐵木兒、也先鐵木兒鈔，人萬五千貫。

translations.literal: On yimao day merit-heirs Sa'ermman, Anhui Temür, and Yesun Temür were each granted fifteen thousand strings of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day merit-heirs Sa'ermman, Anhui Temür, and Yesun Temür were each granted 15,000 strings of notes.

sentences.zh: 以鈔千萬貫，市羊馬給嶺北戍卒，人騬馬二、牝馬二、羊十五。

translations.literal: Ten million strings of notes were used to purchase sheep and horses for Lingbei frontier garrison soldiers — two gelded horses, two brood mares, and fifteen sheep per man.
translations.idiomatic: 10 million strings of notes were used to purchase sheep and horses for Lingbei frontier garrison soldiers — 2 gelded horses, 2 brood mares, and 15 sheep per man.

sentences.zh: 禁驛戶無質賣官地。

translations.literal: Relay-households were forbidden to pawn or sell government land without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: Relay-households were forbidden to pawn or sell government land without authorization.

translations.literal: On bingchen day Dong'an Prefecture was flooded, ruining one thousand five hundred sixty qing of commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Dong'an Prefecture was flooded, ruining 1,560 qing of commoners' fields.

sentences.zh: 戊午，真定路武邑縣南水害稼。

translations.literal: On wuwu day southern Wuyi County in Zhending Route was harmed by floodwaters to the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day southern Wuyi County in Zhending Route was harmed by floodwaters to the crops.

sentences.zh: 奉元行宮正殿災。

translations.literal: The main hall of the traveling palace at Fengyuan was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: The main hall of the traveling palace at Fengyuan was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 上都利用監庫火，帝令衛士撲滅之。

translations.literal: The storehouse of the Shangdu Directorate of Utilization caught fire; the Emperor ordered guards to extinguish it.
translations.idiomatic: The storehouse of the Shangdu Directorate of Utilization caught fire; the Emperor ordered guards to extinguish it.

translations.idiomatic: He then said to the assembled ministers, "Emperor Shizu first built these palace halls, and down to today we dwell in peace within them.

translations.literal: Having succeeded to the great inheritance, yet meeting with this destruction — this is because I have been unable to plan good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Having succeeded to the great inheritance, yet meeting with this destruction — this is because I have been unable to plan good governance.

translations.idiomatic: Imperial Bodyguard soldiers garrisoning the frontier — 1 soldier with accumulated merit requested reward with an official post; the Emperor said, "Are titles and ranks objects with which to reward people?

translations.idiomatic: An order granted him 3,000 strings of notes.

translations.idiomatic: Weixian in Daming Route had prolonged rain; Yansmen garrison farm in Datong Route suffered drought damage to wheat; various guard garrison farms and Yongqing County had flooding; Guixin County in Baoding Route had locusts.

translations.literal: Sixth month, bandits besieged Ningdu; commoner Sun Zhengchen of the prefecture supplied grain to the army — his gate was commended.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bandits besieged Ningdu; commoner Sun Zhengchen of the prefecture supplied grain to the army — his gate was commended.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，西番參卜郎諸寇未平，遣徽政使醜驢往督師。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Canbolang bandits of the Western Tibetans were not yet pacified; Xuanzheng commissioner Choulu was dispatched to oversee the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Canbolang bandits of the Western Tibetans were not yet pacified; Xuanzheng commissioner Choulu was dispatched to oversee the army.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，毀鐵木叠兒父祖碑，追收元受制書，告諭中外。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the steles of Tiemudie'er's father and grandfather were destroyed, the original seals of investiture were recovered, and proclamation was made to inner and outer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the steles of Tiemudie'er's father and grandfather were destroyed, the original seals of investiture were recovered, and proclamation was made to inner and outer.

sentences.zh: 贈乳母忽禿臺定襄郡夫人，其夫阿來追封定襄王，謚忠湣。

translations.literal: Wet nurse Hututai was posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Dingxiang Commandery; her husband Alai was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Dingxiang with the posthumous title Zhong Min.
translations.idiomatic: Wet nurse Hututai was posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Dingxiang Commandery; her husband Alai was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Dingxiang with the posthumous title Zhong Min.

translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Construction Bureau commissioner Hasar Buqa, for deceiving the throne and seeking profit, was beaten and banished to the eastern frontier; his household was confiscated.

translations.idiomatic: The capital garrison office, because of rain, requested capital repairs; an order stated, "This year large earthworks should not be undertaken; merely make basic repairs.

translations.literal: " On guiyou day side chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day side chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple were established.

sentences.zh: 贈燕赤吉臺太赤為襄安王。

translations.literal: Yanchi Jitai's Tai Chi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xiang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yanchi Jitai's Tai Chi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xiang'an.

sentences.zh: 諸王別思鐵木兒統兵北部，別頒歲賜。

translations.literal: Prince Biesi Temür commanded troops in the northern region and was separately granted an annual stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Biesi Temür commanded troops in the northern region and was separately granted an annual stipend.

sentences.zh: 太常請纂修累朝儀禮，從之。

translations.literal: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau requested compilation of rites of successive reigns — this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau requested compilation of rites of successive reigns — this was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，填星犯畢。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Saturn transgressed Net.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Saturn transgressed Net.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，易、安、滄、莫、霸、祁諸州及諸衛屯田水，壞田六千餘頃。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Yi, An, Cang, Mo, Ba, and Qi prefectures and various guard garrison farms were flooded, ruining more than six thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Yi, An, Cang, Mo, Ba, and Qi prefectures and various guard garrison farms were flooded, ruining more than 6,000 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 諸王怯伯數寇邊，至是遣使來降，帝曰：「朕非欲彼土地人民，但吾民不罹邊患，軍士免於勞役，斯幸矣。

translations.literal: Prince Qiebo had repeatedly raided the frontier; now he dispatched envoys to submit; the Emperor said: "I do not desire their land and people — only that our people not suffer frontier calamity and soldiers be spared labor and corvée — that is happiness enough.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qiebo had repeatedly raided the frontier; now he dispatched envoys to submit; the Emperor said, "I do not desire their land and people — only that our people not suffer frontier calamity and soldiers be spared labor and corvée — that is happiness enough.

sentences.zh: 今既來降，當厚其賜以安之。」

translations.literal: Now that they have come to submit, generous gifts should be bestowed to settle them."
translations.idiomatic: Now that they have come to submit, generous gifts should be bestowed to settle them."

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯朔，宣政使欽察臺自傳旨署事，中書以體制非宜，請通行禁止，從之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao new moon, Xuanzheng Commissioner Qinchatai personally transmitted an edict and assumed affairs; the Central Secretariat held this improper by regulation and requested a general prohibition — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao new moon, Xuanzheng commissioner Qinchatai personally transmitted an edict and assumed affairs; the Central Secretariat held this improper by regulation and requested a general prohibition — approved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，占城國王遣其弟保佑八剌遮奉表來貢方物。

translations.literal: On renchen day the king of Champa sent his younger brother Baoyou Balazhe to present a memorial and offer tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the king of Champa sent his younger brother Baoyou Balazhe to present a memorial and offer tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 真定路驛戶饑，賑糧二千四百石。

translations.literal: The postal-households of Zhending Circuit suffered famine; 2,400 shi of grain was granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: The postal-households of Zhending Circuit suffered famine; 2,400 shi of grain was granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太廟成。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 班丹坐贓杖免。

translations.literal: Bandan was flogged and dismissed from office on charges of corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Bandan was flogged and dismissed from office on charges of corruption.

sentences.zh: 賜剌禿屯田貧民鈔四十六萬八千貫市牛具。

translations.literal: 468,000 ingots of notes were granted to impoverished peasants of Latu garrison-farm to buy oxen and farm implements.
translations.idiomatic: 468,000 ingots of notes were granted to impoverished peasants of Latu garrison-farm to buy oxen and farm implements.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諸王帖木兒還自雲南，八宿衛，賜鈔二萬五千貫。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Prince Temür returned from Yunnan; after eight days on palace guard duty he was granted 25,000 ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Prince Temür returned from Yunnan; after 8 days on palace guard duty he was granted 25,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，招諭左右兩江黃勝許、岑世興。

translations.literal: On yisi day amnesties and summons were issued to Huang Shengxu and Cen Shixing of the Left and Right Two Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day amnesties and summons were issued to Huang Shengxu and Cen Shixing of the Left and Right Two Rivers.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封諸王忽都鐵木兒為威遠王，授金印。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Prince Qutu Temür was enfeoffed as Prince Weiyuan and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince Qutu Temür was enfeoffed as Prince Weiyuan and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 減海道歲運糧二十萬石，並免江淮增科糧。

translations.literal: The annual grain transport by sea route was reduced by 200,000 shi, and the additional levies on Jiang-Huai grain were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The annual grain transport by sea route was reduced by 200,000 shi, and the additional levies on Jiang-Huai grain were also remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，買馬行宮駕車六百五十匹。

translations.literal: On jiayin day 650 horses were purchased for the imperial carriage train.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day 650 horses were purchased for the imperial carriage train.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，永寧王卜顏鐵木兒為不法，命宗正府及近侍雜治其傅。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Prince Yongning Buyan Temür acted unlawfully; the Imperial Clan Court and palace attendants were ordered jointly to try his tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Prince Yongning Buyan Temür acted unlawfully; the Imperial Clan Court and palace attendants were ordered jointly to try his tutor.

sentences.zh: 籍鐵木叠兒家資。

translations.literal: Temüder's household property was registered and confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Temüder's household property was registered and confiscated.

sentences.zh: 諸王徹徹禿入朝請印，帝以其政績未著，不允，賜鈔二十五萬貫。

translations.literal: Prince Cheche Tu came to court requesting a seal; the Emperor, holding that his achievements were not yet distinguished, did not approve, but granted 250,000 ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Cheche Tu came to court requesting a seal; the Emperor, holding that his achievements were not yet distinguished, did not approve, but granted 250,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 御史臺請降旨開言路，帝曰：「言路何嘗不開，但卿等選人未當爾。

translations.literal: The Censorate requested an edict opening the avenue of remonstrance; the Emperor said, "The avenue of remonstrance has never been closed — only you have not selected the right men.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate requested an edict opening the avenue of remonstrance; the Emperor said, "The avenue of remonstrance has never been closed — only you have not selected the right men.

sentences.zh: 」漷州雨，水害屯田稼。

translations.literal: " Huozhou rain; floodwater damaged garrison-farm crops.
translations.idiomatic: " On Huozhou, rain flooded and damaged garrison-farm crops.

sentences.zh: 真定州諸路屬縣蝗，冀寧、興和、大同三路屬縣隕霜。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of Zhending Prefecture's various circuits had locusts; dependent counties of the three circuits of Jining, Xinghe, and Datong had frost fall.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Zhending Prefecture's various circuits had locusts; dependent counties of the 3 circuits of Jining, Xinghe, and Datong had frost fall.

sentences.zh: 東路蒙古萬戶府饑，賑糧兩月。

translations.literal: The Eastern Route Mongol wanhu office suffered famine; two months' grain was granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Route Mongol wanhu office suffered famine; 2 months' grain was granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 英宗性剛明，嘗以地震減膳、徹樂、避正殿，有近臣稱觴以賀，問：「何為賀？

translations.literal: Emperor Yingzong was resolute and clear-sighted. Once when an earthquake occurred, he reduced his meals, withdrew music, and avoided the main hall; a close minister raised a cup to congratulate him, whereupon he asked, "What is there to congratulate?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong was resolute and clear-sighted. Once when an earthquake occurred, he reduced his meals, withdrew music, and avoided the main hall; a close minister raised a cup to congratulate him, whereupon he asked, "What is there to congratulate?

sentences.zh: 朕方修德不暇，汝為大臣，不能匡輔，反為諂耶？

translations.literal: I am still occupied with cultivating virtue — you are a great minister, yet instead of assisting me you flatter me?
translations.idiomatic: I am still occupied with cultivating virtue — you are a great minister, yet instead of assisting me you flatter me?

sentences.zh: 」斥出之。

translations.literal: " He had him dismissed and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: " He had him dismissed and expelled.

sentences.zh: 拜住進曰：「地震乃臣等失職，宜求賢以代。

translations.literal: Baizhu stepped forward and said, "The earthquake is due to our ministers' dereliction of duty; worthy men should be sought to replace us.
translations.idiomatic: Baizhu stepped forward and said, "The earthquake is due to our ministers' dereliction of duty; worthy men should be sought to replace us.

sentences.zh: 」曰：「毋多遜，此朕之過也。

translations.literal: " He said, "Do not over-disclaim — this is my fault.
translations.idiomatic: " He said, "Do not over-disclaim — this is my fault.

sentences.zh: 」嘗戒群臣曰：「卿等居高位，食厚祿，當勉力圖報。

translations.literal: " Once he admonished the multitude of ministers, saying, "You hold high office and receive generous stipends — you should strive with all your strength to repay the state.
translations.idiomatic: " Once he admonished the multitude of ministers, saying, "You hold high office and receive generous stipends — you should strive with all your strength to repay the state.

sentences.zh: 茍或貧乏，朕不惜賜汝；

translations.literal: If any among you are in want, I do not begrudge bestowing gifts upon you;
translations.idiomatic: If any among you are in want, I do not begrudge bestowing gifts upon you;

sentences.zh: 若為不法，則必刑無赦。

translations.literal: but if you act unlawfully, punishment shall certainly be without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: but if you act unlawfully, punishment shall certainly be without pardon.

sentences.zh: 」八思吉思下獄，謂左右曰：「法者，祖宗所制，非朕所得私。

translations.literal: " When Basijisi was imprisoned, he said to those at hand, "Law is what the ancestors established — it is not mine to apply privately.
translations.idiomatic: " When Basijisi was imprisoned, he said to those at hand, "Law is what the ancestors established — it is not mine to apply privately.

sentences.zh: 八思吉思雖事朕日久，今其有罪，當論如法。

translations.literal: Though Basijisi has long served me, now that he is guilty he should be judged according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Though Basijisi has long served me, now that he is guilty he should be judged according to law.

sentences.zh: 」嘗禦鹿頂殿，謂拜住曰：「朕以幼沖，嗣承大業，錦衣玉食，何求不得。

translations.literal: " Once, holding court at Deer-top Hall, he said to Baizhu, "I succeeded to the great enterprise in my youth and inexperience — brocade robes and jade fare, what could I not obtain?
translations.idiomatic: " Once, holding court at Deer-top Hall, he said to Baizhu, "I succeeded to the great enterprise in my youth and inexperience — brocade robes and jade fare, what could I not obtain?

sentences.zh: 惟我祖宗櫛風沐雨，戡定萬方，曾有此樂邪？

translations.literal: Only my ancestors, enduring wind and rain, subdued the myriad regions — did they ever have such pleasures?
translations.idiomatic: Only my ancestors, enduring wind and rain, subdued the myriad regions — did they ever have such pleasures?

sentences.zh: 卿元勛之裔，當體朕至懷，毋忝爾祖。

translations.literal: You are descended from founding ministers — you should embody my deepest intent and not disgrace your forebears.
translations.idiomatic: You are descended from founding ministers — you should embody my deepest intent and not disgrace your forebears.

sentences.zh: 」拜住頓首對曰：「創業惟艱，守成不易，陛下睿思及此，億兆之福也。

translations.literal: " Baizhu kowtowed and replied, "Founding an enterprise is arduous; preserving it is not easy — that Your Majesty's wise thought reaches thus far is the fortune of the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: " Baizhu kowtowed and replied, "Founding an enterprise is arduous; preserving it is not easy — that Your Majesty's wise thought reaches thus far is the fortune of the hundred millions.

sentences.zh: 」又謂大臣曰：「中書選人署事未旬日，御史臺即改除之。

translations.literal: " He again said to the great ministers, "The Central Secretariat selects a man to assume office, and before ten days have passed the Censorate replaces him.
translations.idiomatic: " He again said to the great ministers, "The Central Secretariat selects a man to assume office, and before 10 days have passed the Censorate replaces him.

sentences.zh: 臺除者，中書亦然。

translations.literal: When the Censorate appoints someone, the Central Secretariat does the same in turn.
translations.idiomatic: When the Censorate appoints someone, the Central Secretariat does the same in turn.

sentences.zh: 今山林之下，遺逸良多，卿等不能盡心求訪，惟以親戚故舊更相引用邪？

translations.literal: Now beneath the mountains and forests there are many reclusive talents — can you not earnestly seek them out, but only mutually recommend relatives and old friends?
translations.idiomatic: Now beneath the mountains and forests there are many reclusive talents — can you not earnestly seek them out, but only mutually recommend relatives and old friends?

sentences.zh: 」其明斷如此。

translations.literal: " Such was his clarity and decisiveness.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was his clarity and decisiveness.

sentences.zh: 然以果於刑戮，奸黨畏誅，遂構大變云。

translations.literal: Yet because he was resolute in inflicting punishment, the villain faction feared execution and thus engineered the great mutiny — so it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because he was resolute in inflicting punishment, the villain faction feared execution and thus engineered the great mutiny — so it is said.
